clue.text: Desert traveller arrived needing shelter, right?

parts.note: arrived means came
the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind

explanation.surface: A traveller crossing the desert reaches somewhere and needs cover, asking whether that is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: A cameleer drives or rides camels, the classic way of crossing a desert.

clue.text: Riverside worker's job? They will get money transferred

definitions.meaning: someone working by a river might be tidying its sides, clearing the banks
banks that settle cheques and transfers between each other through a central system

explanation.surface: A question about a riverside labourer's work, then a note on who moves cash about.
explanation.definitionFit: Big high-street banks belonging to the clearing system move funds between accounts; the first reading is a whimsical literal take.

clue.text: University head, one leading a perfect place

indicators.note: leading means the word one comes in front of the following a

parts.note: the head of something is its top
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A university's chief is someone who leads in an ideal setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Utopia, from Thomas More's book, is an imagined ideal society.

clue.text: People transacting business in a toilet

parts.note: the Gents is the British name for a men's public toilet

explanation.surface: Deals being done in a public lavatory.
explanation.definitionFit: Agents act on behalf of others in commercial dealings, the sense of brokers or representatives.

clue.text: Surprisingly, erudite man set value too low

indicators.note: surprisingly says these letters turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A learned man, unexpectedly, priced something too cheaply.
explanation.definitionFit: To underestimate is to judge or price something lower than it deserves, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Rule-breaker's heartless talk

indicators.note: heartless means the central letter of the word for rule-breaker is cut out

parts.note: someone who breaks the rules is a cheat

explanation.surface: Someone who broke the rules is speaking without feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A chat is an informal conversation, a plain synonym for talk.

clue.text: Sort of dance — guess everyone can join in

indicators.note: join in says the word for everyone goes into the middle of the word for guess

parts.note: to bet is to wager on a guess
everyone means all

explanation.surface: An invitation to try a dance where the whole crowd can take part.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballet is a formal theatrical form of dance, so it is one kind of dancing.

clue.text: Some booing and hissing great leader

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A crowd jeers at a celebrated leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahatma Gandhi led India's independence movement and is widely revered as a great leader.

clue.text: Woman appears in very short time

parts.note: very in short form is V
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A woman shows up only briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: Vera is a female first name, so it stands for a woman.

clue.text: Initially Paul can't eat cooked chopped pork

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of Paul
cooked means these letters are mixed up as if prepared in a kitchen

explanation.surface: Paul is unable to eat pork once it has been prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: Pancetta is Italian cured pork belly, usually sold diced or sliced for cooking.

clue.text: Articles rubbished performances

indicators.note: rubbished means wrecked, so the letters of articles are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Newspaper pieces panned some shows.
explanation.definitionFit: Recitals are musical or poetry performances, often by a solo artist.

clue.text: The French love a group of stars

parts.note: le is French for the
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: French people adore a constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: Leo, the Lion, is a constellation of the zodiac.

clue.text: English mother offers something for the cheese board

parts.note: a dam is an animal's mother

explanation.surface: An English mum contributes an item for the cheese course.
explanation.definitionFit: Edam is a round Dutch cheese with a red wax coat, a typical item on a cheese board.

clue.text: Bill has one channel for outflow — polluted showers?

parts.note: AC, short for account, is a bill
I is the Roman numeral one
a drain carries waste water away

explanation.surface: An invoice includes a channel for runoff, with a hint at dirty downpours.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid rain is rainfall made acidic by air pollution, so showers of it are polluted.

clue.text: Boast, giving support before start of game

indicators.note: before puts the word for support ahead of the next piece

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of game

explanation.surface: Someone shows off by backing a side before a match begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To brag is to boast, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Bird and dog drink

parts.note: a cock is a male bird
to dog someone is to follow them, to tail them

explanation.surface: A bird and a dog share a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dog' reads as a noun but works as the verb meaning follow.
explanation.definitionFit: A cocktail is a mixed alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Copper on trial is most astute

indicators.note: in a down clue, on puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a trial is a test

explanation.surface: A police officer in court is the sharpest of all.
explanation.definitionFit: Cute can mean shrewd or clever, so the cutest is the most astute.

clue.text: Shiny surface in little church, see

parts.note: CH is the short form of church
Rome is the Holy See, the Pope's seat

explanation.surface: Something gleaming sits inside a small chapel, look.
explanation.definitionFit: Chrome is chromium plating, giving a bright reflective finish.

clue.text: Let a rose become untidy shrub

indicators.note: become untidy says these letters get disordered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Allow a rose to grow into an unkempt bush.
explanation.definitionFit: The oleaster is a shrub or small tree, the wild olive.

clue.text: Bird left Noah's vessel

parts.note: Noah built the Ark

explanation.surface: A bird flew off the Ark.
explanation.definitionFit: The lark is a songbird, the skylark being the best known.

clue.text: Revolutionary name for famous brothers

definitions.meaning: Karl, author of the Communist Manifesto
Groucho, Chico, Harpo and Zeppo, the comedy film siblings

explanation.surface: A rebel's surname is shared by a well-known set of siblings.
explanation.definitionFit: Karl the political thinker and the Hollywood comedy siblings share one surname.

clue.text: Second-rate garden tools in carriages

parts.note: B is a second-class grade
rakes are garden tools

explanation.surface: Poor-quality gardening tools are stored in wagons.
explanation.definitionFit: A brake (or break) is an old horse-drawn carriage, often an open wagonette.

clue.text: Array has fanciful art in blend

indicators.note: in puts the shuffled art inside the word for blend

parts.note: to blend is to mix

indicators.note: fanciful means the letters of art are reimagined in a new order

explanation.surface: A display containing imaginative artwork in a mixture.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a matrix is a rectangular array of numbers.
